verdict.rationale: Airbyte's schema change management docs state that you can set, per connection, how Airbyte handles any source schema change. That directly matches choosing a propagation policy instead of letting loads break silently. Missing for 10: the specific policy options (e.g. propagate, ignore, pause) are not enumerated, detection mechanics and alerting on schema changes are not documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, upstream schema changes are detected and propagated by a policy I choose, instead of silently breaking loads

citations.quote: You can specify for each connection how Airbyte should handle any change of schema in the source.
